title: Up and down
description: Two to four things, each with an arrow that draws itself up or down beside the word. For 'this goes down, that goes up'.

props.items: 2-4 rows: {text: the thing, dir: "up" | "down", at}; the words up / down are shown only if you put them in sub
props.color: colour of the arrows going up
props.color2: colour of the arrows going down
